finalText:
Fixed. The bundle stage was crashing because `resolveRelease` merged config layers with a plain `Object.assign`, which replaces a whole nested object (`output`, `sourcemap`) instead of merging its keys — so a package overriding just `output.format` lost `output.dir` entirely.

`packages/shared/config.js:13-24` now merges `output` and `sourcemap` one level deep at each layer (defaults → package overrides → CLI flags), so a partial override only changes the key it names.

`node build.js` exits 0 with 5 warnings, 0 errors, and `node verify.js` — which specifically checks the merge isn't just patched around with hardcoded keys — also passes.
